question: Where, when, and of what size should the ritual pit be dug?
premises: A pit measuring a cubit is to be dug
The pit is dug in the middle of the ground
The digging occurs on an auspicious day
inference: On an auspicious day, one should dig a cubit-measure pit in the middle of the ground.
plain_english: Having dug a pit measuring a cubit in the middle of the ground on an auspicious day.
